stem:
Esha needs a length unit the whole class can share. Someone suggests a handspan; someone suggests the metre; someone names the centimetre as the SI unit of length.

Which is suitable as a standard unit?

options.text: The centimetre named as the SI unit of length.
The metre, so everyone uses the same agreed length.
No shared unit is possible for length.

teacher.key_rationale: A standard unit is shared and agreed. The metre is that unit for length.
